title: Cops Find Kidnapped Woman Alive in Storage Container
description:
Bodycam footage shows Ohio police finding a woman stuck in a plastic storage container after being kidnapped. Authorities said Dalontay Reshawn allegedly put her in the container after a series of horrific events. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
